campaign_question: Can model-specific vertical co-design materially reduce quality- and SLO-adjusted GLM-4.7-Flash inference cost relative to tuned general stacks and providers?

measured_support.provider_and_hardware: Nebius repeatedly supplied one H100 SXM 80GB; placement, SSH, telemetry, retrieval, and teardown work.

fixed_stock_performance.workload: 16 requests, concurrency 8, exactly 8192 input and 1024 output tokens per request
fixed_stock_performance.slo: passed every replication with 100% success and no detected truncation

derived_compute_only_economics.classification: analytical estimate derived from measured fixed-workload throughput and vendor list price

measured_support.operational_overhead: Cold VM, container, and model delivery consumed roughly 18-19 minutes before teardown on successful stock allocations; model delivery later failed twice with public Hub CAS 401s.

analytical_context.interpretation: Even a minimally positive MTP result would be far too small to close the current analytical cost gap.

untested_or_unresolved: MTP performance was not measured because two changed model-delivery paths ended in CAS 401 before inference; this is not negative MTP evidence.
No matched Fireworks or Baseten workload, quality, SLO, or price measurement exists.
No quality-adjusted cost point exists because the frozen absolute screen failed.
No quantized 48GB intervention has passed full GPU load, quality, and throughput gates.
falsification_summary: The stock stack is fast enough to meet the scoped latency SLO but not analytically cheap enough at the measured H100 rate.
Reasoning-off prevents small-case truncation, and a 32K server admits the frozen long-context case, but these serving/representation changes did not make the absolute quality screen pass.
A 5% decode optimization cannot materially change the current business conclusion.
pivot_conditions: Resume with a quantized representation or materially cheaper GPU that has a credible path to at least 3x cost reduction and can pass a freshly calibrated, prospectively frozen quality suite.
Alternatively obtain a managed exact-model provider control and run the same frozen workload, quality policy, and SLO for a matched comparison.
If MTP is revisited, stage the exact model artifact in authenticated storage before allocation and treat the result as mechanism evidence until absolute quality passes.
forbidden_claims: GLM-4.7-Flash is cheaper than Fireworks or Baseten
the compact synthetic screen is a general model-quality verdict

budget.reason_unspent: terminal decision supported; further identical delivery or stock allocations have low information value
